description: A 1HP sine wave FM operator in the DX7 mould, with exponential and linear modulation inputs and self feedback

params.text: Shifts the pitch in octaves, -8 to +8
Attenuates the signal at the exponential FM input before it reaches the frequency
Sets the modulation index, the depth of linear frequency modulation from the three LFM inputs
Multiplies the base frequency by a ratio, so the operator runs at a fixed interval from the pitch it is given
Feeds the operator's own output back into its own frequency, 0 to 4

inputs.text: A signal modulating the frequency exponentially, scaled by the FM knob
One of three signals summed into the linear frequency modulation
A voltage setting how much of the three linear FM inputs reaches the frequency
A pulse resets the phase of the sine wave
Drives the base frequency from another oscillator patched here

outputs.text: Carries the pitch voltage this operator is reading, for passing the same pitch on to the operators modulating it

notes: placed immediately to the right of another of these, the module becomes its modulator with no patching
as a modulator it reads the pitch voltage of the operator on its left and sends its own output into that operator's linear FM input
a purple lamp lights on an operator working as a carrier and a blue lamp on one working as a modulator; a yellow lamp lights while the incoming tuning has been detached
menu: Reset to C4 — sets the octave and tuning back to C4, with Reset to C3, Reset to C2 and Reset to C1 beside it
Detach Tuning from Left Expander — leaves this operator tuned by its own OCT and TUNE rather than by the module to its left
